lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Smoke on the crossing. Those raiders reached the old road before us.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Then we hold here. The trees and stonework will slow their charge.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: I can keep the wounded standing, but the marsh is tainted. Do not end your move there unless you must.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: Break their line. Take the crossing before dusk.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Stoneford is a thin wall, but it is still a wall. Rest, train, and strike before the raiders gather.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Give us the route and we will keep their scouts away from the bridge.

lines.speaker: Sella
lines.text: Coin is lighter than regret. If you are heading into the woods, carry medicine and check your blades.

lines.speaker: Tovin
lines.text: I saw marked stones near the old road. They knew where our patrol would turn.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Then the next fight is not random. We should watch the flanks and force them through bad ground.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Tracks split beyond the bridge. Same boots, same spacing. They are baiting us into the crossing again.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Then we choose the ground first. Keep clear of the tainted marsh and make them cross our lines.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The river leaves us one road forward. I will hold the bridge; strike past me when the line opens.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: No room for a wide flank. Timing and reach will decide this one.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Four roads, broken carts, and tracks on every side. They want us watching the wrong lane.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Then we take the center carefully and use the wreckage to divide their fire.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The thornwood has three usable lanes. The middle is fast, and that makes it the obvious trap.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: We pressure the center and turn one flank before they can shift support.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The stone islands are safe. Everything violet between them will drain life from anyone who lingers.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: A dangerous shortcut is still a shortcut. We use it only when the action order gives us an exit.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: These halls connect behind the broken walls. An enemy lost from sight may reappear on our flank.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: We choose one lane to hold and one to turn. No one crosses the center alone.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: You crossed road, wood, and marsh to reach my walls. Now learn what those walls were built to do.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Clear one wing, then the yard. We end this without letting the keep split us apart.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Chapter 1. The old road is the first line. Clear the raiders before they turn a raid into a siege.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. We move fast, learn their habits, and come back with proof.

lines.speaker: Tovin
lines.text: The pine line bends toward the crossing. Their archers used those trunks to vanish after each shot.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Then we do not chase blindly. Watch the lanes, cut their sight, and make the forest work for us too.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Stay in pairs. If they want an ambush, deny them a lonely target.

lines.speaker: Tovin
lines.text: Chapter 2. The markers continue into the pinewood. Whoever placed them expected our patrol route.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. Stay in formation and use the forest before they use it against us.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The old stones are soaked through. That violet water is not natural, and it will punish anyone who lingers.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: A hard route, then. We move cleanly, finish quickly, and leave no one stranded in the marsh.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: Come deeper, bridge-keepers. The ruins remember how to bury soldiers.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Chapter 3. The trail ends in the sunken stones. The marsh around them is fouled by more than rot.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: Large field, many enemies. If you want the truth behind Stoneford, come take it from the ruin floor.

lines.speaker: Sella
lines.text: Chapter 4. A supply wagon is missing on the cart road, and Stoneford cannot hold without those crates.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. We strike quickly and bring back what the outpost needs.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Chapter 5. Their scouts finally carry a banner mark. This is no loose band of thieves.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. Break the scouts before they report our strength.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Chapter 6. Lanterns are burning under the marsh water. Someone is using the ruins to signal.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Large field, many enemies. We cut the signal before their next column moves.

lines.speaker: Tovin
lines.text: Chapter 7. I owe Stoneford more than a warning. I know a shortcut the enemy thinks is hidden.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. A narrow path can save time or become a trap.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Chapter 8. A flanking column is moving through the pinewood. If it reaches us, the gate falls.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. Hold formation and stop them before the trees open.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Chapter 9. These ruin marks are names, not directions. Someone important is moving behind the raids.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Large field, many enemies. We take the marker and force their commander into the open.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Chapter 10. They mean to burn Stoneford bridge before dawn.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Midpoint battle. Small field, few enemies, but every turn matters.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Chapter 11. Captured orders name the ash road. This invasion has a timetable.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. If we delay them here, the schedule breaks.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Chapter 12. The drowned gate is opening. The reserve force was hidden beneath the ruins.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Large field, many enemies. We close the gate by force.

lines.speaker: Tovin
lines.text: Chapter 13. A courier rides at dusk with orders for the rear guard.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. We intercept before the message leaves the road.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Chapter 14. The pinewood is no longer cover. They shaped it into a trap.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. Keep sight lines clean and do not chase shadows.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: Chapter 15. You have been useful. Every road you defended showed me what Stoneford fears.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Boss operation. Large field, many enemies. This time we break Voss's guard.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Chapter 16. Stoneford is done waiting. Lead the counterattack down the road.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. A clean victory here gives the outpost room to breathe.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Chapter 17. The pines are black before dawn. The enemy thinks darkness belongs to them.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Medium field, normal enemy count. Stay close until the ambush breaks.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Chapter 18. False lights across the marsh are trying to split us.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Large field, many enemies. Ignore the bait and keep the action order under control.

lines.speaker: Captain Elric
lines.text: Chapter 19. The last column is moving on the old road. If it joins the main force, Stoneford is surrounded.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Small field, few enemies. One clean interception before the final banner falls.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: Chapter 20. No banner, no witness, no retreat. Stoneford ends at dawn.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Final battle. Large field, many enemies. We finish the road here.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The hidden command is broken. Stoneford still stands.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Twenty battles for one road. Tomorrow, people will cross it without counting the trees for archers.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Ending reached. The five-hour campaign spine is now present from Chapter 1 to Chapter 20.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The marker was not a bandit's sign. It belongs to an army that has not shown its banner yet.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: Then Stoneford was only the opening move. We have seventeen battles left before this road is safe.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Prototype ending reached. The full plan is twenty chapters, each built around a short story scene and a tactical battle.

lines.speaker: Rook
lines.text: The road is ours. Count the wounded and secure the crates.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: They were testing our route. Someone knew we were coming.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Then this was not the last fight. We should move before another banner arrives.

lines.speaker: Iron Voss
lines.text: The crossing falls. Leave none able to carry word.
